content: Host survey deltas found while scoping A/V streaming (devague frame a-v-streaming), 2026-07-24, operator workstation: (1) gst-launch-1.0 IS installed — the brief claim of no capture backend is stale; plugins present: v4l2src/pulsesrc/alsasrc, jpegenc/vp8enc/theoraenc/opusenc/wavenc/lamemp3enc, matroskamux/mp4mux/avimux/oggmux, splitmuxsink/hlssink2/tcpserversink/fdsink; x264enc ABSENT so no H.264 encode. ffmpeg/v4l2-ctl/fswebcam still absent. (2) C270 PipeWire card active profile is off — no PulseAudio source exists for the Logitech mic; direct ALSA capture from hw:1,0 verified working (1s arecord). Arducam and Reachy mics DO have PipeWire sources. (3) Operator is in the audio group but NOT the video group — video access rides the logind seat ACL (user:spark:rw-), so a headless agent loses cameras but keeps mics. (4) Reachy Mini Audio showed Subdevices 0/1 (held open by another process) — live proof of the Q4 exclusive-access failure mode. (5) Current mapping: C270=video0/1+card1, Arducam=video2/3+card3 — swapped vs the brief, confirming plug-order instability.

content: webcam-cli capture artifacts are consumed by LOCAL AI MODELS, not human media players — the `lobes` fleet on the Thor machine (thor@100.105.216.63), where the `worker` lobe (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 MoE, the eighth Colleague role, the fast ground-work DOER) was added around 2026-07-31 behind an opt-in Docker Compose profile. Operator confirmed 2026-07-31 that machine decodability is the bar, NOT player compatibility. Consequences: (1) The Opus constraint added alongside the issue-#5 muxing fix — --rate limited to 8000/12000/16000/24000/48000 Hz, --channels <= 8, raised as a typed user error rather than a silent resample — is ACCEPTABLE and approved; do not remove it or add a silent resample to widen playback compatibility. (2) `worker` is a TEXT/generate lobe and cannot read frames itself; in the Thor fleet the multimodal reader is `senses` (coolthor/gemma-4-12B-it-NVFP4A16) and audio-to-text is `stt` (nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2, not loaded by default). Vision models take IMAGES, not containers — which is an independent argument for the MJPG-passthrough-in-Matroska choice over re-encoding to VP8, since individual JPEG frames extract trivially while VP8 needs a decode pass. (3) Thor has ffmpeg with libx264; the spark host does NOT have ffmpeg at all, so any transcode belongs on Thor. Context: issue #5 = record --kind video/audio wrote headerless raw byte streams with no container through published 0.8.0; stream and --kind av were unaffected.
